components.explanation: The three exported props (castle, windkey, toybox) as binary glTF with +Y Up, and their Godot import settings (scene importer, root scale 1.0). Built in Blender from primitives: castle and windkey through the Blender MCP, toybox by the script route; the toybox band green is the student's hand edit (08f96cd).
prop_room.tscn: floor, one DirectionalLight3D, the saved Camera3D at (0, 1.6, 5.5) and the three instanced props at x = -2.2, 0 and 2.0.

tests/check_props3d.gd: headless check of size vs brief (±0.01 m), base at y = 0, scale/rotation, tallest axis, triangle budget, albedo and front side, plus placement in the room via to_root(); its first version falsely passed the room check (global_transform outside the tree).

tools/shot_prop_room.gd and tools/shot_prop_views.gd: Claude-made engine renders of the prop room (evidence/godot/prop_room.png and the six views); the views script first hit the same not-inside-tree mistake.

var diff: Vector3 = (box.size - (spec.size as Vector3)).abs()
		check(diff.x <= TOL and diff.y <= TOL and diff.z <= TOL,
			"size %s matches brief %s within %.2f m" % [box.size, spec.size, TOL])
		check(absf(box.position.y) <= 0.005, "base at y=0 (min_y %.4f)" % box.position.y)
		check(inst.scale.is_equal_approx(Vector3.ONE) and nodes_ok, "scale (1,1,1) and rotation 0 on scene and mesh nodes")
		if spec.tall_axis != "":
			check(box.size.y >= box.size.x and box.size.y >= box.size.z, "tallest axis is Y (stands upright)")
		check(tris <= spec.budget, "triangles %d <= budget %d" % [tris, spec.budget])

# Transform of n relative to the scene root, built from local transforms so it
# works before the node is inside the tree (global_transform does not: a first
# version of this check used it, got the identity, and "passed" the room check
# without testing placement at all).
func to_root(n: Node) -> Transform3D:
	var t := Transform3D.IDENTITY
	while n != null and n != root:
		if n is Node3D:
			t = (n as Node3D).transform * t
		n = n.get_parent()
	return t
